title: Fluidstack signs 10-year, 168 MW lease at Cipher's Barber Lake (~$3B)

sources.quote: The agreement represents approximately $3 billion in contracted revenue over the initial 10-year term and includes two five-year extension options.

explain: Fluidstack will rent 168 megawatts at Cipher's Barber Lake site in Texas for 10 years, worth about $3 billion. Google backstops $1.4 billion of Fluidstack's obligations and got warrants for about 5.4% of Cipher.
